purpose: Display host-provided online, away, busy or offline availability with explicit accessible meaning.
behaviorProvider: Native noninteractive markup with a decorative dot and explicit text or accessible name.

component: Map the four explicit status values to semantic availability colors and visible status labels by default. A custom label replaces both visible and accessible text.
With showLabel=false expose a named image role. With decorative=true hide the entire presentation from assistive technology because the host must convey that meaning elsewhere.
host: Own status freshness, subscriptions, privacy and localized labels.
Prefer a visible label where users need to distinguish states without color. Use StatusBadge for record workflows and Indicator for positioned notification counts.

requirements.statement: Map the four explicit status values to semantic availability colors and visible status labels by default. A custom label replaces both visible and accessible text.
With showLabel=false expose a named image role. With decorative=true hide the entire presentation from assistive technology because the host must convey that meaning elsewhere.
Hide the dot itself from assistive technology and provide no live-region announcements, event handlers, timers or presence inference.
Own status freshness, subscriptions, privacy and localized labels.
Prefer a visible label where users need to distinguish states without color. Use StatusBadge for record workflows and Indicator for positioned notification counts.

Use data-display group tokens for owned presentation and preserve any genuine nested component ownership. Validate all four theme/mode mappings, logical directions and compact layout without changing dimensions between themes.

limitations: No online detection, connection health check, presence transport or expiry policy is implemented.
Written coverage is separate from actual browser, visual, accessibility and package evidence.
